gate.question: Does every quantitative claim and epistemic qualifier in PUB2 trace cleanly to a banked, on-main source, with zero internal inconsistencies remaining?
gate.why: Three separable reasons, none of them substantive. (1) On-main: 23 of the traced claims -- all of section 3's leg-163 material -- resolve only on the parked branch origin/leg/163-h2s-v1, not on main (P1). (2) Cleanly: 6 quantitative sites mismatch their banked source -- four bounds printed 0.005-0.51 % tighter than the data allow (N1-N4), one provenance sentence printed twice that derives a correct number by a chain that did not happen (N5), one subject-attachment slip at the sixth decimal (N6). (3) Zero internal inconsistencies: 5 remain (C1-C5), the largest being seven-vs-seventy legs across four sites.
gate.plus: one epistemic disclosure gap (E1) that is not a mismatch with any source but is the highest-priority rework item: the headline digit 0.0908 is convention-relative by a factor of 12.5 and PUB2 never says so, which leg 249 flagged in exactly those words.
gate.escalation: NO -- every finding is prose, provenance or precision. Zero change an argument. Leg 249's own invariance statement is what keeps E1 below the escalation line.
gate.what_reproduces: 88 of 94 quantitative sites match their banked source exactly, including all 15 Z_1 battery cells, all 8 columns of the section 4.3 window table, both 7-cell G3 exponent rows, the full 8-rung sigma_min ladder with leg 268's K1 digit correction applied, and leg 274's A2 increment/decrement subject fix applied correctly. 0 of 5 truncation-independence sites regenerate the defect legs 250/268/271/274 removed. 0 float64 measurements are described with proof-language.
